why: Signal fills an entire tissue layer and vessel walls like autofluorescence; no distinct NGFR-positive nerves, glia or cells show at any scale.
notes: NGFR lights a whole muscle-like layer and vessel rings evenly, and the brightest-cell close-up (D) is only haze. CD21 is also uniform haze, so the partner check (row E) is uninformative. No specific nerve or glial structure is visible.
